description: This file defines the TextFragment class and related classes for handling text segments, including indexing, comparison, and iteration functionalities within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: Represents a segment of text with indexing, comparison, and traversal capabilities.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: Provides iteration over segments of a TextFragment, supporting splitting and traversal based on delimiters.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the TextFragment to an empty state.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a character at a specific index within the fragment.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between TextFragments, strings, or character arrays.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between TextFragments, strings, or character arrays.

methods.name: OnMarker
methods.description: Checks if the fragment starts with given characters.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the fragment is empty.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the text fragment.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of the text data.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns the text of the fragment as a string.

methods.name: EqualText
methods.description: Compares the text with another fragment or string, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: ForwardFind
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a delimiter character or string starting from an offset.

methods.name: ForwardSkip
methods.description: Skips characters until a non-delimiter is found.

methods.name: ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a delimiter character or string.
